title: AAT Architecten line reveal
description: A paragraph (or heading) whose lines rise one after another out of their own invisible masks the first time it scrolls into view: each line slides up about a line's height on a long expo ease, 80ms behind the one above. The text is plain and fully visible in the static HTML.
notes: needs JavaScript (hydrate: idle) to measure where the lines break; before that, and without JavaScript, the text simply shows
lines are re-measured on mount only; resizing after the reveal has no effect
name: aat-architecten-line-reveal

props.name: text
props.description: the text; it is split into words, and the words into the lines the browser breaks them into

props.name: step
props.description: delay between one line and the next, in seconds
